demo.title: jungle-bay.sh
demo.code:
# Any wallet's heat: held time, read from the chain. Price never enters.
curl -s https://memetics.wtf/api/heat/<wallet>

# Every coin the island measures today
curl -s https://memetics.wtf/api/state/island

# Every flame, warmest first
curl -s https://memetics.wtf/api/flames

setup: Ask your agent: what's my heat? Heat is held time, read from the chain; price never enters
Put both of your Bankr wallets on one flame: `use the jungle-bay skill to put me on the island`
See every flame, warmest first: https://memetics.wtf/flames
